aggregateInsights.travelUnknownNote: {{count}} provided responses have no safely classifiable country or are pooled. They are not counted as Canadian. The displayed count is a minimum, not the full international total.
aggregateInsights.residenceNote: Country of residence, not travel origin or citizenship. Missing responses are excluded.
aggregateInsights.travelNote: Only explicit country names/codes are classified. City-only, ambiguous and missing answers are not assumed to be Canadian or international.
aggregateInsights.rangeNote: The lower bound counts explicit non-Canadian responses; the upper bound also includes pooled or unclassified answers. Small subgroups are not revealed.
aggregateInsights.pooled: Pooled other/suppressed responses: {{value}} · {{share}}% of this population. The group’s overall size is visible; its individual categories remain hidden.
aggregateInsights.pooledMentions: {{value}} pooled category selections. These are overlapping mentions, not unique people or projects.

coverageDetails: Missing answers, suppression and exact coverage
comparisonNote: Compare each category’s share of the two populations, not raw bar lengths on different bases. These are application rows linked to attendance, not all Tracker attendees.
sessionLabelsNote: Repeated names are separate event records. Record numbers distinguish them; they do not imply chronological order. Dates were not retained in this snapshot.
eventPopulationNote: Unique people within each event record. People can appear in several rows; do not add the rows to estimate total attendees.
findingConfirmed: {{count}} of {{total}} confirmed Tracker participants checked in. Another {{unmatched}} checked-in participants had no confirmed RSVP.
findingLinkage: {{count}} of {{total}} application rows are not linked to Tracker; cohort outcomes do not cover every application.
attendanceLinkageUnavailable: The retained Devpost snapshot has no attendee-matching aggregate. It cannot establish which checked-in people submitted projects.

project.pageCoverageNote: Visible fields on every submitted project’s organizer page, not validated links. Team-school information is unavailable from this source.
project.pageTeamNote: {{memberships}} visible team memberships across {{answered}} submitted projects; Devpost reports {{people}} submitters. Memberships are not unique people. Team size counts the member cards shown under Created by.
project.pageSource: Organizer totals and all submitted-project pages reviewed {{date}} · {{requests}} team-up requests. Draft totals come from the submission filter; draft project details are excluded.
project.conversionCounts: {{to}} of {{from}} registrants were on submitted teams · {{gap}} did not submit
project.populationNote: Devpost participation is separate from applications and event attendance; these exports do not match people to check-ins.
project.base: Submitted projects n={{total}} · {{answered}} supplied this field · {{missing}} missing
project.overlap: Projects can select several categories. Percentages use all submitted projects and need not sum to 100%.
project.noCategories: No categories with at least five submitted projects.
project.suppression: {{count}} category labels with fewer than five projects are omitted.
project.completenessNote: Nonblank fields on submitted projects, not checks that links work or content is complete.
project.teamNote: {{memberships}} team memberships across {{answered}} projects with a supplied team size; Devpost reports {{people}} submitters. Memberships are not unique people. Team size is one project creator plus the additional-member count.
project.method: Drafts are excluded from charts. Technology tags are case-normalized and counted once per project, without merging spelling aliases. Prize selections overlap and indicate interest, not eligibility or awards. Rare team sizes are pooled.
project.source: Organizer totals and project export captured {{date}} · {{requests}} team-up requests · {{duplicates}} duplicate export rows removed.

history.comparisonNote: Read each event’s definition alongside its numbers. Populations and capture methods differ: these are not a combined funnel, and no cross-event percentage change is calculated.
history.matchedTurnout: {{to}} of {{from}} confirmed pre-registrants checked in · {{drop}} without a check-in
history.anyScanNote: Includes meals and workshops, even without an explicit check-in. This is a different attendance base.
history.overlapNote: Categories can overlap. Their counts must not be summed as a people total.
history.languageMethod: Case-insensitive keyword mentions, not proficiency or exhaustive technology coverage. The report’s C++ pattern matched lowercase only; this SQL-based count includes both C++ and c++. Other language counts reproduce the report’s patterns.
history.profileBase: Population n={{total}} · Each field is counted independently.
history.rawCategoryNote: Stored category spellings are retained. Variants have not been silently merged; small categories are pooled.
history.coverageNote: Bars show percent answered. Missing values are counted separately from pooled small categories.
history.eventBase: Any-scan population n={{any}} · explicit check-in population n={{check}}. Each percentage uses its matching population.
history.repeatedLabels: HTH II scans identify a label, not an event instance. Repeated labels are counted once across all sittings; participants can appear in several activity rows.
history.insightNote: Team membership is platform registration, not proof of a submitted Devpost project. Profile counts indicate supplied fields, not validated links. Form duration describes elapsed submission time, not time actively filling it out.
history.staffNote: Users may hold several staff roles and login providers. Role assignments are not distinct staff members; provider counts overlap.
history.privacyNote: Only aggregate data is retained. Raw answers, contact details, profile links, audit text and credentials are excluded. Categories below five are pooled; accommodation text is not displayed.

stat.formsOverHour: Submitted after more than one hour
stat.foodPeople: Unique people with a food scan

quality.duplicateRegistrations: Registration rows beyond distinct email identities
quality.scanWithoutCheckIn: People scanned without an explicit check-in

populationNote.registrations: Cleaned HTH I base · rows, not unique people
populationNote.walkIns: HTH I only · excluded from the funnel

i.funnelNote: In-person pre-event registrations only. Acceptance status is unavailable in this schema, so no acceptance stage is invented. Stage cards count rows; turnout below deduplicates identities.
i.turnoutNote: In-person confirmed pre-registrants; distinct nonblank normalized email identities. Check-ins are reconstructed from the audit trail, not directly observed event-specific flags.
i.logisticsNote: A zero transportation flag can mean either “no” or unanswered. Nonblank accommodation responses include negative answers and are not a count of needs.
i.method: The April 2024 dump was reused for HackHers. Exclude its 16 audited walk-ins; undo each person’s earliest February 3, 2024 checkedIn edit by restoring the opposite recorded value. This reproduces 377 check-in records and the PDF’s 273/426 in-person turnout. It assumes the audit trail is complete. The notebook excludes attendance, whereas the PDF includes this reconstruction; this dashboard follows the reproduced PDF method.

populationNote.registrations: All Hacker rows · includes day-of registrations
populationNote.checkIn: Distinct people with an explicit Check-In scan

ii.funnelNote: One matched population: pre-event application → accepted → accepted and confirmed → explicit check-in. Walk-ins are excluded throughout.
ii.turnoutNote: Accepted and confirmed pre-event registrations, with an explicit Check-In scan. Any-scan attendance is tracked separately.
ii.logisticsNote: Meal totals deduplicate each label/person pair and sum its maximum recorded value. Nonblank accommodation responses include negative answers and are not a count of needs.
ii.method: The October 2024 dump reproduces 1,196 registrations, 1,073 pre-event applications, 610 accepted, 607 accepted and confirmed, 476 explicit check-ins and 534 people with any scan. Presence stores labels rather than event IDs; joining repeated labels to every scheduled instance would multiply totals. Scans do not prove absence when a record is missing.

iii.turnoutNote: Confirmed Tracker participants matched to a positive check-in. Application rows and provisioned Tracker participants are separate source populations.

history.mealBoundsNote: Bounds transcribed from printed page 33 of the corrected HTH II PDF; service totals match the SQL aggregates. Floating portions may belong to either sitting. The ranges are correlated: do not add both lower bounds or both upper bounds.

coverageByDimensionNote: Coverage uses all application rows. A range means missing answers may be pooled in suppressed categories. Acquisition-channel counts may overlap.
projectLinkageNote: Aggregate matches from the retained Devpost snapshot. Submitters include team members. Missing matches do not prove non-participation.
judgingSourceComparison: {{public}} public Devpost projects · {{gap}}-project difference between sources.
projectPipelineNote: These compare source totals, not tracked project-level transitions. A roster gap may reflect imports, eligibility, or later changes; it is not a participant drop-off.
analysisGuideNote: Compare category size with acceptance and attendance rates, not counts alone. Explore schools, geography, prior hackathon experience, language, and acquisition channels in the cohort explorer. Event operations separates unique people from repeatable service activity.
analysisUnavailable: The HTH III aggregate snapshot has no exact-age averages, team-size distribution or post-event survey results. Historical editions have separate sources and definitions.
judgingRosterProjects: Projects imported into the judging roster
noCategoryCounts: No non-zero category counts for this cohort.
zeroCountsNote: The table includes every category. Zero counts are omitted from the chart.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed. The last successfully loaded metrics are still displayed.
attendanceOutcomesDescription: Matched Tracker records, not the difference between total RSVPs and total attendees. Attended walk-ins are a subset of attendees, not an additional total.
rsvpBreakdown: Tracker RSVP status: {{confirmed}} confirmed · {{declined}} declined · {{pending}} pending
projectStatuses: Project status: {{publicProjects}} public submitted · {{hiddenProjects}} hidden submitted · {{draftProjects}} drafts
multiSelectNote: Applicants could select multiple channels. Counts overlap and are not exclusive attribution.
cohortConversionNote: Rates show the numerator and denominator for each category. Rates with fewer than five starting rows, or pooled suppressed categories, are not shown. Attendance is compared with acceptance because attendance is not necessarily a subset of confirmed RSVPs.
title: Operational metrics
provisionedDescription: Everyone created in Track the Hack, whether or not they attended.
confirmedDescription: People who confirmed that they planned to attend.
checkedInDescription: Unique people with recorded evidence that they attended.
walkInDescription: Participants registered as walk-ins, whether or not attendance has been recorded.
presencesDescription: Recorded units across check-in, food, merchandise, and event attendance. A person may contribute more than once.
funnelDescription: Application and acceptance rates use rows from the same Sheet snapshot. RSVP → attendance uses confirmed Tracker participants with a recorded check-in.
conversionDetail: {{from}} started · {{to}} reached the next stage · {{dropOff}} drop-off
conversionUnavailable: The source snapshot for this conversion has not been synced.
applicationsDescription: Completed application rows in the restricted Google Sheet at the last aggregate sync.
acceptedDescription: Application rows currently marked Accepted at the last aggregate sync.
acceptanceEmailsDescription: Acceptance messages AWS SES accepted for delivery. This does not prove inbox delivery and may count more than one message per person.
devpostProjectsDescription: Projects in the latest judging roster imported from Devpost.
devpostRegistrantsDescription: People registered for the event on Devpost.
devpostActiveRegistrantsDescription: Registrants counted as active in Devpost's organizer metrics.
devpostSubmittersDescription: People included on a submitted project, including team members.
devpostSubmittedProjectsDescription: Public and hidden submitted projects; drafts are excluded.
demographicsDescription: Categories with fewer than five applicants are combined as Other / suppressed.

dimension.acquisitionChannel: How applicants heard about Hack the Hill

dataQualityDescription: Coverage and reconciliation checks identify where funnel counts may be incomplete or where source systems disagree.
sheetUnlinkedRows: Application rows not linked to Tracker
devpostApplicationMatches: Devpost registrants matched to an application
devpostUnmatchedRegistrants: Devpost registrants without an exact application email match
devpostMatchedSubmitters: Matched application identities on a submitted team
uniqueAttendanceDescription: Each participant is counted at most once per event.
recordedUnitsDescription: The sum of recorded values. Food, merchandise, or repeatable workflows may count a person more than once.
eventEngagementDescription: Known attendees grouped by the number of distinct non-check-in activities with a positive presence record.
integrityAttention: One or more attendance checks need attention.
positivePresenceWithoutCheckIn: Positive event presences missing Known-attendee status
mealCategoryDescription: All provisioned participants; this is not limited to people currently known to have attended.
tShirtSizeDescription: All provisioned participants; this is not limited to people currently known to have attended.
